parameter.name: host
parameter.label: IP or Hostname
parameter.description: IP address or hostname of the device

parameter.name: key
parameter.label: Key
parameter.description: Encryption key for HTTP devices, exchanged with the device automatically when empty

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Refresh interval in seconds. For CoAP devices, which push their updates, the interval at which the connection is checked.

parameter.name: humidityOffset
parameter.label: Humidity Offset
parameter.description: Humidity sensor readings offset used for correction

parameter.name: temperatureOffset
parameter.label: Temperature Offset
parameter.description: Temperature sensor readings offset used for correction (in Celsius)
